entries.reason: The resolved glib 0.18.5 source carries the exact gtk-rs VariantStrIter soundness backport; RustSec identifies the unchanged compatibility version rather than the patched source bytes.
evidence: Resolved 2026-08-15: Cargo patches glib to vendor/glib while retaining version 0.18.5 for the Tauri 2.11.5 GTK3/WebKitGTK graph; Cargo.lock no longer resolves the glib package from the registry.

The vendored tree is derived from crates.io package SHA-256 233daaf6e83ae6a12a52055f568f9d7cf4671dabb78ff9560ab6da230ce00ee5 and applies only gtk-rs backport commit ea720152f28e293ef4362ee844ee5cc499f32d2a to VariantStrIter::impl_get.

scripts/lib/verify-glib-backport.mjs seals the complete patched vendor tree and requires the mutable pointer plus &mut p call, the exact upstream/package provenance, the active Cargo patch, and a path-resolved lock entry.
The release gate builds an optimized temporary consumer that exercises next, next_back, nth, nth_back, and last against the patched source.
entries.upgradeCondition: Remove this version-only scanner disposition when the Tauri Linux stack reaches glib 0.20 or later, or when RustSec recognizes an official patched 0.18 release; reject any change that disables or alters the sealed backport in the meantime.
